biggervaults.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.h: Storing Fluids in Tiered Fluid Tanks
biggervaults.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.t: Tiered Fluid Tanks can be used to store large amounts of fluid
Pipe networks can push and pull fluids from any side
The contained fluid can be measured by a Comparator
However, in Survival Mode fluids cannot be added or taken manually
Basins, Item Drains and Spouts can drain or fill fluid-containing items

biggervaults.ponder.fluid_tank_boiler.te: Tiered Fluid Tanks can produce more steam than ordinary Fluid Tanks.
Each material tier increases the maximum power of the boiler.
The boiler can only reach that power when supplied with enough water and heat.
Higher tier Steam Engines can convert the increased steam into greater rotational force.
Using a lower tier Steam Engine limits the usable output and wastes the remaining steam.
